run_forward_batch_generation: run a forward batch generation on a tensor parallel model worker with optional speculative decoding
update_weights_from_tensor: update model weights from deserialized tensors with a specified load format on a TP worker
load_lora_adapter_from_tensors: load a LoRA adapter from deserialized tensors using flattened bucket or standard format
init_weights_update_group: initialize a distributed weights update group with master address, port, and backend configuration
forward_batch_embedding: run a forward pass for embedding generation and return the embedding pooler output
